meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才的对话变成可复用的技能。它读取来源、提炼步骤和踩坑点,生成或更新 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md(可附带辅助文件),也能就地改进已有技能。
howto.when: 当用户说“/learn”并给出目录、网址、粘贴的笔记,或说“learn this”“capture this workflow”等,想把当前工作流变成技能时触发。若要求安装现成社区技能则不触发。

say.note: 读取目录并生成对应技能。

say.text: /learn 把刚才的部署流程变成技能
say.note: 把当前对话的步骤提炼成 SKILL.md。
读取旧版并就地改进,避免重复。

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation into a reusable skill: reads the source, distills repeatable steps and gotchas, writes/updates .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with optional extras.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'capture this workflow', etc., or asks to make/improve a skill from a source. It does not trigger for installing existing community skills.

say_en.note: Reads the directory and builds a skill for it.

say_en.text: /learn turn what we just did into a skill
say_en.note: Distills this conversation's workflow into SKILL.md.
Refines the existing skill in place.
